name: Precalculus
summary: Functions and their graphs, polynomial, rational, exponential and logarithmic functions, complex numbers and basic vectors: the direct preparation for calculus.

topics.name: Functions: domain, range, notation and graphs
Transformations and combinations of functions; composition
Linear and quadratic functions and models
Polynomial functions: zeros, factor theorem and end behaviour
Exponential functions and growth and decay models
Logarithms: properties, change of base and solving equations
Complex numbers: arithmetic, polar form and De Moivre's theorem
Vectors in the plane: components, dot product and applications
Systems of equations and an introduction to matrices
Sequences, series and the binomial theorem
Intuitive idea of a limit and rates of change
